uncertainty_semantics.CONFIRMED: Fused probability >= confirmed threshold (0.70 or 0.75 depending on mode) with supporting identity evidence.
uncertainty_semantics.AMBIGUOUS: Score within ambiguous band [0.40, 0.70) or incomplete identity evidence.
uncertainty_semantics.REJECTED: Physically impossible transition, incompatible vehicle type, or guarded cross-model Re-ID.
uncertainty_semantics.unconfirmed_singleton: Single camera observation not confirmed across multiple cameras; assigned confidence null (not fake 1.0).
